info.about: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep is a 2010 action role-playing game developed and published by Square Enix in collaboration with Disney Interactive Studios for the PlayStation Portable, serving as the sixth installment in the Kingdom Hearts series. The game was released on UMD worldwide in 2010.
info.trivia: A prequel with three protagonists, later remastered in the PS3 collection.
info.why: Common, and the remaster covers most players, so prices are moderate.
